title: Equal tuning, readout sensitivity and where BRAN loses eye information
legend:
**Extended Data Fig. 4 | Equal tuning, readout sensitivity and where BRAN loses eye information.** Same 26 conditions, 1,928 AI-READI development participants and five folds as Fig. 3.
**a**, All 25 arms of the tuned benchmark, each with its own penalty chosen by nested cross-validation, and BRAN's native heads (square). Left, tuned macro AUROC with the fixed C = 1 estimate (open diamond). Right, BRAN combined minus each arm, with ticks at prespecified (black) and all-arm (grey) one-sided Bonferroni bounds.
**b**, Macro AUROC of BRAN combined and four foundation-model arms with clinical data under fixed, shared and per-arm tuned penalties, with tuned minus fixed AUROC and each prespecified bound.
**c**, Eye-alone macro AUROC and the prespecified decision family, compression loss (BRAN retinal input minus state) and input deficits (foundation model minus input), with bounds over eight tests and a 0.010 margin (dashed).
**d**, R8 retinal-route retrain minus R7 and its acceptance gates.
Points, estimates. Bars, 95% participant bootstrap intervals (1,000 shared draws) unless stated. Adverse results. Tuned BRAN combined tied RETFound-Green, DINOv3 and Labrador with clinical data, raw clinical values plus age, raw clinical and retinal concatenation, every PCA-64 arm and its own clinical route, and its prespecified bound cleared zero only against VisionFM (**a**). VisionFM with clinical data chose the lowest C on the grid in 57 of 130 condition-fold cells, so its tuned AUROC may be underestimated. BRAN's advantage was smallest under per-arm tuning (**b**). BRAN lost eye information when compressing its retinal input (**c**). R8 lowered eye-alone AUROC by 0.0051 [0.0015, 0.0089], failed two gates and was not adopted, and a later R8 check stopped on a technical failure (**d**). A label-free BRAN comparison and the original RETFound arm are PLACEHOLDER.
methods_notes:
a. Same people, folds and conditions as Extended Data Fig. 3c. Every logistic arm has its own C, chosen for each condition and outer fold by the mean validation log loss over five inner folds on a 13-point log grid from 0.0001 to 100, and gradient boosting chooses its number of iterations the same way. PCA is fitted inside every training split, PCA-192 matches the 192 dimensions of the BRAN state and PCA-64 keeps the first 64 axes. BRAN combined scored 0.6954 [0.6861, 0.7052]. Only VisionFM with clinical data had a prespecified bound above zero (+0.0171). The supplementary all-arm family, not prespecified, was above zero for the BRAN retinal route, RETFound-Green plus age, DINOv3 plus age, VisionFM plus age, Labrador plus age, blood tests plus age and all five PCA-192 arms and at or below zero for the BRAN clinical route, raw clinical and retinal concatenation, gradient boosting on raw clinical values plus age and all five PCA-64 arms. With marginal paired intervals BRAN combined exceeded the BRAN retinal route, RETFound-Green plus age, DINOv3 plus age, VisionFM plus age, VisionFM with clinical data, Labrador plus age, blood tests plus age, gradient boosting on raw clinical values plus age and all five PCA-192 arms and tied the BRAN clinical route, RETFound-Green with clinical data, DINOv3 with clinical data, Labrador with clinical data plus BRAN eye features, raw clinical and retinal concatenation, raw clinical values plus age and all five PCA-64 arms, with no losses. Tuning raised every foundation-model arm by +0.0431 to +0.0715. For every representation PCA-64 scored above PCA-192, by +0.0115 to +0.0178, and RETFound-Green PCA-64, DINOv3 PCA-64 and VisionFM PCA-64 had higher point estimates than BRAN combined. Gradient boosting scored 0.6835 [0.6745, 0.6926]. BRAN's native heads scored 0.7026 [0.6926, 0.7120], and BRAN combined minus the native heads was −0.0072 [−0.0111, −0.0034] (Fig. 3a and Fig. 3c). VisionFM plus age chose the smallest C in 86 of 130 condition-fold cells, VisionFM with clinical data in 57 and Labrador plus age in 21, and gradient boosting chose the smallest iteration count in 68, so the grids may be too narrow for those arms. The BRAN state saw the 26 labels, so the equal-tuning comparison with a label-free or label-held-out BRAN state is PLACEHOLDER.
b. The shared C is the C that nested selection chose for raw clinical values plus age in each condition and fold, applied to every arm. BRAN combined moved by +0.0204 between the fixed and tuned readouts and the four foundation-model arms by +0.0503 to +0.0572, consistent with C = 1 under-regularising their wider feature vectors. The median selected log10 C was −1.5 for BRAN combined and −4.0 to −2.5 for the eight foundation-model arms. Under the shared C all five prespecified bounds were above zero (+0.0051 to +0.0446). The size of the BRAN advantage depends on how the penalty is chosen. For raw clinical values plus age it was smallest under the fixed readout (difference −0.0089 [−0.0179, +0.0001], bound −0.0192).
c. Eye alone with typed age, per-arm nested tuning on the tuned benchmark folds and shared bootstrap draws, at least 1,920 people. Decision family, first arm minus second arm with one-sided Bonferroni bounds over 8 tests. Compression loss, BRAN retinal input plus age minus BRAN retinal state plus age, +0.0104 [+0.0019, +0.0199] over 26 conditions and +0.0179 [+0.0001, +0.0366] over the four eye conditions, a material loss on both. Input deficits, each foundation model minus BRAN's 384 adapted input features, RETFound-Green +0.0032 [−0.0032, +0.0091], VisionFM +0.0065 [−0.0006, +0.0140] and DINOv3 +0.0016 [−0.0047, +0.0086] over 26 conditions, inconclusive on eye conditions. The prespecified option map selected retrain option B, which keeps the adapted input and retrains only the retinal route. The BRAN encoder saw the 26 labels and the input features and foundation models did not. The original RETFound arm is PLACEHOLDER because its weights are not held locally.
d. Option B retrained the retinal route with the clinical route frozen and R7 as the frozen teacher, under gates fixed before training. Tuned eye alone, R8 minus R7 was over 26 conditions −0.0051 [−0.0089, −0.0015], over the four eye conditions −0.0009 [−0.0095, +0.0070] and over the 22 others −0.0059 [−0.0101, −0.0018]. The native combined-route macro changed by −0.0089 against a tolerance of −0.005 (R7 0.7026, R8 0.6937). Gates g4a and g4b failed and the integrity gates passed, so R7 stays the reported model throughout and no outcome analysis used R8. The R8 Stage A check then stopped with a technical failure (broad_clinical_state_v1_contract_failed) before any outcome file was parsed, which could not change the decision.
